title: Efficient electroreduction of CO2 to C1 and C2 products using atomically dispersed boron N–C@graphite catalysts
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00260E, Paper
Open Access

Farzaneh Yari, Simon Offenthaler, Sankit Vala, Dominik Krisch, Wolfgang Schöfberger
Boron NC@graphite catalysts function as efficient, noble-metal-free electrocatalysts for CO2 conversion to CO and C1/C2 products. Boron subphthalocyanines represent a new, scalable class of molecular electrocatalysts.
